verification.notes: Remington documents a 150-grain .30-06 Core-Lokt soft-point load, and hearing testimony explains that lead/core material can split on impact. But the reviewed public case evidence does not establish that the recovered case ammunition was conclusively identified as that exact Remington product, so the general ammunition description is supported while the case-specific identification is not.
